summary: Tested new 'Scansione Etichette' feature (handwritten label scan via POST /api/scan-etichetta). Backend 5/5 pytest passed; Gemini 3 Flash consistently reads the real handwritten webp (3/3 attempts) returning candidati containing {codice:'2619-019331', pedane>=1}; >8MB upload returns 413; blank image returns candidati [] without crash. Frontend scan flow works end-to-end on web at 390x844: tap magazzino-scan-button → (permission sheet) → scan-allow-camera-button → file chooser → scan-reading-overlay 'Lettura etichetta…' → magazzino-search-input value becomes '2619-019331' and the 2 real Peter Brozulat GmbH pedane for order 25023487 are listed, with toast 'Letto: 2619-019331'. ONE UI ISSUE FOUND: horizontal overflow of the search bar at 390x844 — document.scrollWidth=488 while viewport=390, so the magazzino-scan-button renders at x=398 (right edge 450), 60px outside the viewport. The TextInput's intrinsic content width (fontSize 30, placeholder 'Posizione o N° ordine') prevents it from shrinking below ~360px, pushing the scan button off-screen on narrow mobile viewports. The input, clear button and scan button do NOT all fit at 390x844 as required by the test spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390x844: document.scrollWidth=488 while viewport is 390. magazzino-scan-button is positioned at x=398 (right edge 450) — 60px outside the viewport. Root cause: the TextInput (fontSize 30 with the long placeholder 'Posizione o N° ordine') keeps its intrinsic content width on RN Web, so flex:1 does not shrink it. Fix: on the search TextInput style add minWidth: 0 (React Native Web requires minWidth:0 to allow a flex child to shrink below its content size). Alternatively reduce input fontSize to 22-24 and/or shorten the placeholder. File: /app/frontend/app/magazzino.tsx:540 (styles.input) and the inputWrap at :528.

issues: Search box container overflows viewport by ~98px at 390x844; scan button only reachable via horizontal scroll on a real device.
Non-blocking console warning observed from RN Web: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (not scan-related, surfaced during the test).

action_items: Fix magazzino search bar overflow at 390x844: in /app/frontend/app/magazzino.tsx add `minWidth: 0` to styles.input (RN Web flex-shrink fix). Verify docScrollWidth === window.innerWidth after fix and that magazzino-scan-button bbox.x + bbox.width <= 390.
(Optional) Consider lowering the input fontSize from 30 to ~24 on narrow viewports, or using a shorter placeholder, to keep touch targets inside the viewport.

rca_of_issue: Search bar overflow RCA: inputWrap has flexDirection:row with children [magnify icon 28] + [TextInput flex:1] + [clear 34] + [scan 52] plus 14+6+14 horizontal padding (~96px fixed). On RN Web, a flex child's default `min-width` is `auto` (content-based). The TextInput has fontSize:30 and placeholder 'Posizione o N° ordine' (~17 chars). The intrinsic content width is ~360px, so flex:1 cannot shrink it, forcing the inputWrap to render at ~456px which exceeds the 358px available inside searchCard (390 - 2*16 padding). Repro: open /magazzino at viewport 390x844 → evaluate document.documentElement.scrollWidth → 488. Mitigation: add `minWidth: 0` to styles.input (the standard RN Web flexbox shrink fix). Verified by inspection — no code change applied here (design/visual decision left to main agent).
